verdict.rationale: Secureframe publishes a public REST API reference at api.secureframe.com/docs. It uses resource-oriented JSON:API endpoints, request/response schemas for every endpoint group, an embedded OpenAPI 3.0 definition and a documented versioning policy, and the feature page says the API can reach any object in the account. That gives an AI-native user a documented, machine-readable way to drive the product programmatically. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the API in use, and a separately downloadable raw OpenAPI spec (the spec is only embedded in the reference page).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: Secureframe exposes a REST API for use by customers, partners, and community developers. The Secureframe API utilizes resource-oriented endpoints and returns requests in the form of standard JSON responses, based on the JSON API spec.
the document embeds the full "openapi: 3.0.0 / info: title: Secureframe API" OpenAPI definition that the renderer consumes
Backwards _incompatible_ changes require Secureframe to release a new dated API version
Use Secureframe’s API to connect to any existing object in your Secureframe account.
